notes:
- The app is now called **Tumbler**.
- Form fields now appear in their correct position and size, matching the
  layout of the original document (fixes forms such as the UK N244 where every
  box was drawn at the left edge).
- Reordering pages by dragging thumbnails now works reliably, with a clear
  blue insertion line showing exactly where the page will land.
- Clicking an existing sticky-note icon now opens the note instead of adding
  a new one on top of it.
- Automatic updates: Tumbler now checks for new versions and offers to
  install them.
